levels.name: Hovedhallen plan 1
levels.note: Main concourse: ticket office (Entur, between tracks 8 and 9), ramps and travelators to tracks 1–12, stairs and lifts to tracks 13–19, most shops. Includes 'Passasjen'. oslo-s.no labels Peppes Pizza, Boots, Burger King, Döner Bros, 7-Eleven Hovedhallen, Deli de Luca, Upper Crust, Bake Me Up, Smoothie Xchange, La Baguette, Pronto di Olivia, Swift by Sumo, Vita, Mester Grønn, Dressmann XL, b.young, Ichi, Accessorize, Joker and two Narvesen units 'Hovedhallen plan 1'. OSM tags most of these level 2 (Peppes, Boots, Burger King, Dressmann XL, Narvesen, Vita, 7-Eleven Jernbanehallen, Deli de Luca, Upper Crust, Smoothie Xchange, La Baguette, Ichi), so plan 1 = OSM level 2.
levels._source: https://oslo-s.no/spisesteder/burger-king/, read 2026-10-30; Oslo S magasinet 03/2026 (https://oslo-s.no/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2026/08/OsloSmag_03_2026_web.pdf), p. 6 map legend 'Slik finner du frem hos oss', read 2026-10-30; Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-o-/oslo-s/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract NO-OSL_S), read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Hovedhallen plan U
levels.note: Lower floor under the main hall: Hard Rock Cafe, Vinmonopolet, the Speed luggage lockers (reached from Flytogterminalen towards Østbanehallen, or by the escalator in the corridor by Deli de Luca), Oslo Visitor Centre, photo booths. OSM tags Vinmonopolet and the luggage lockers level 1, so plan U = OSM level 1. Caution: oslo-s.no prints the line 'Hovedhallen plan U' above the same station-map image on many pages, so a second 'plan U' line on a shop page may just be the map label.

open: Floor heights: no open source measures them.

The station-map image (Kart-Oslo-S-2025_mars-1.jpg) could not be read, so positions within each hall are mostly OSM's. Only some places have a 'where' in words: ticket office between tracks 8 and 9, toilets opposite La Baguette by the escalator to Flytogterminalen, lockers via the escalator by Deli de Luca, Starbucks on the second floor, Narvesen by inngang nord, Flytoget machines at track 10.

Lifts to tracks 13–19 (Bane NOR) are not in the OSM extract. The extract also lacks the main-line platforms 1–19: its platform list holds only metro, tram and bus stops. Lift positions on those platforms are still open. [Lift follow-up 2026-10-30: The raw OSM extract does have the main-line platforms as relations: 13;14 r4121520, 15;16 r4121517, 17;18 r4121519, 19 r6825728. No lift lies within 3 m of any of them. The nearest, hall lift n5039388333 (1;2), is 27 m from 17;18. The only main-line platform lift in OSM is n4291296610, from footbridge w429931729 to platform 3/4. Bane NOR's June 2026 tender plans lifts from the underpass to all platforms. Lifts to tracks 13–19 are not settled.]

oslo-s.no and the magazine disagree on where some places are. La Baguette and Pronto di Olivia: plan 1 (web) vs Flytogterminalen (magazine). Oslo Visitor Centre: plan U (web) vs Østbanehallen (magazine). Magazine entries 19–23 (Deli de Luca, Upper Crust, Entur, Bake Me Up, Smoothie Xchange) have no clear section heading. Burger King appears on both plan 1 and plan 2.
Several shop pages print a second location line, 'Hovedhallen plan U', which may just be the map label. It was ignored where the page also gives another level.
Joker Oslo S hours on oslo-s.no ('Hver dag 08:00–18:00') look unusually short for a station grocery, and OSM says 05:00/06:00–24:00. This needs checking.

OSM places in or near the station that are not on oslo-s.no's current lists were left out: Gladkokken (2 nodes), Steam kaffebar (Østbanehallen, OSM level 0), Eye Factory, Joker Plaza, and everything in Byporten, Oslo City and Galleri Oslo/the bus terminal (Mix, Joker Oslo bussterminal, Espresso House Galleriet, BIT, Forex). Steam and Gladkokken may have closed.

Entrance streets: only inngang nord (Biskop Gunnerus' gate, Bane NOR) and the Jernbanetorget side are named by owner text. The sea-side/Flytogterminalen street (Trelastgata) relies partly on OSM. The magazine labels 'OPERAEN' and 'BUSSTERMINALEN' exits without naming streets.
Bane NOR's English page differs from the Norwegian page on ticket-office hours (06:30–23:15 vs 07:30–20:00) and the bus-terminal distance (200 m vs 300 m). The Norwegian page and oslo-s.no were used.
Temporary: inngang nord is partly closed in weeks 43–47 of 2026 (Bane NOR notice).

answers.question: Levels' real names as signposted
answers.answer: oslo-s.no and its magazine use 'Hovedhallen plan U', 'Hovedhallen plan 1' (incl. 'Passasjen'), 'Hovedhallen plan 2', 'Flytogterminalen' and 'Østbanehallen'. Shops tagged in OSM match them to OSM levels 1, 2, 3 and 0. Flytogterminalen is a mix of 0 and 1. These are website names; the station signs themselves were not seen.
